concerns.text: Missing tasks for FR-003 (Metric Extraction), FR-004 (T-Test Primary), FR-008 (Sensitivity Analysis), and SC-001/SC-002 (Significance Measurement). While T022-T028 exist, they are unchecked and lack explicit [FR-NNN] tags or descriptions confirming they implement the SPECIFIED primary method (t-test) vs the PLAN's conflicting method (Mann-Whitney). The tasks do not explicitly cover the 'correlation analysis' required by SC-003 in US-3.

Tasks T019a and T019b (Manual Audit and Error Rate) are unchecked and lack explicit linkage to SC-004. The description in T019b incorrectly states 'secondary detector score (FR-007) as ground truth' which contradicts SC-004 (Human Expert Judgment is ground truth). This task description needs correction to match the spec, and the task itself must be marked to ensure SC-004 is satisfied.
